source.title: Density-Matrix Expansion for an Effective Nuclear Hamiltonian
source.extraction: Manually transcribed from rendered original table; decimal text retains printed precision.
source.transcription_status: independent original-table visual cross-check passed for all 148 printed independent B/C/D entries
source.physics_status: Literal printed table violates its own coefficient construction; copying it correctly does not validate the physical model.

convention.definition: F(x,y) = sum_{i,j} F_ij x^i y^j, x,y in fm^-3
convention.matrix_order: rows are i; columns are j; zero-based indices
convention.B: B(rho_q,rho_other) multiplies tau_q; B is NOT symmetric
convention.C: C(rho_q,rho_other) multiplies |grad rho_q|^2; C is NOT symmetric
convention.D: D(rho_n,rho_p) multiplies grad rho_n dot grad rho_p once (no extra 2)
convention.NV1973_bulk: Use NV1973 Table 1 V_NM, NOT NV1972 Table I V_NM or V_Reid
convention.B_range: i=0..7, j=0..7; explicitly printed row 7 has only j=0 nonzero
convention.C_range: i=0..6, j=0..7; explicitly printed row 6 has only j=0 nonzero
convention.D_range: i=0..6, j=0..6; upper triangle below; reconstruct lower by symmetry

spin_orbit.provenance_caveat: Author-selected coefficient from ref. 1, explicitly not directly related to two-body effective interaction in NV1972; retain original value, do not fit it anew.
spin_orbit.NV1973_functional: H_so = W0/2 * grad(rho_n + 2 rho_p) dot J_p
spin_orbit.NV1973_source: NV1973 pp307-308, neutron spin-orbit omission and variational proton-only replacement

source_inconsistency.stronger_average_density_G: G(n,p)=U((n+p)/2) has empty six-significant-digit rounding intersections at total degrees 4,5,6; unresolved
source_inconsistency.weaker_general_symmetric_G: With printed B,C fixed, all inferred G_ab/G_ba intervals agree and all 28 independent D entries except D03 agree; D03 is conditionally inconsistent
source_inconsistency.uniqueness_caveat: D03 repair is conditional on fixed B,C; allowing B04 to change gives an alternative isolated repair. The original intended coefficients are not uniquely determined.

needed_primary_clarification.requested_content: The full effective-interaction construction and complete spin/isospin-channel G^SE, G^TE, G^SO, G^TO radial/density/energy-dependent parameter tables used by NV1972 ref.2, sufficient to evaluate NV1972 Eq3.7 and the Eq3.8-3.11 derivatives; alternatively an author-corrected B/C/D table or original implementation.

source_inconsistency.acceptance: Quarantine any newly generated strict-original EOS until source consistency is resolved; diagnostic repair must retain distinct model identity and empirical validation status.
